notes: Deadlines are the IP Paris application-portal sessions for 2027 entry (shared admissions page); EU/EEA applicants and some profiles apply via MonMaster with different dates. No English test score is stated on the programme pages except IELTS >= 6 for Electrical Engineering; other levels are CEFR (B2/C1) and kept in prerequisites. Year-level and major sub-pages of Physics, Mechanics, Nuclear, Energy, Mathematics and Applications (mostly French-language) were not individually snapshotted; their programme pages are covered. Academic Regulations for Master programs are PDF-only and were not used. Ecole polytechnique MScT programmes are not listed on the IP Paris masters page and were not collected.
